options.text: Before you start, you must request AVS quota allocation for your subscription
- If you are an Enterprise agreement (EA) customer, you need to log a support request to allocate hosts
- If you are an CSP customer, use Microsoft Partner Center to make this available for your customers

- Provide a valid non-overlapping CIDR address block. Azure VMware Solution takes the minimum /22 network you provide and divides it into smaller segments used for vCenter, VMware HCX, NSX-T, and vMotion.

Before you start, you must request AVS quota allocation for your subscription:
- If you are an Enterprise agreement (EA) customer, you need to log a support request to allocate hosts.
- If you are an CSP customer, use Microsoft Partner Center to make this available for your customers.

Provide a valid non-overlapping CIDR address block. Azure VMware Solution takes the minimum /22 network you provide and divides it into smaller segments used for vCenter, VMware HCX, NSX-T, and vMotion.

elements.name: avsAddressSpace
elements.label: AVS Address Space
elements.toolTip: This CIDR represents the Private Cloud Management network and will be used for the cluster management services (i.e vCenter Server, NSX-T Manager, etc.). Please provide a CIDR prefix of a minimum of /22 address space. The prefix address should be unique and should not overlap with any other Azure or on-premises networks that will communicate with the Private Cloud.

elements.name: jumpboxVmName
elements.label: Jumpbox VM name
elements.toolTip: Enter a name 1-15 characters long, using only letters and numbers (no spaces).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter 1-15 alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers only), with no spaces.

elements.name: HighPerformanceVM
elements.label: High-Performance VM
elements.toolTip: Optional: Enable high performance attributes for the VM. (Set storage type to Premium and enable Accelerated Networking.

elements.name: jumpboxLocalUserName
elements.label: Username
elements.toolTip: Provide username for the Jumpbox local admin account.

toolTip.password: The password must be alphanumeric, contain at least 8 characters, have at least 1 letter, 1 number and 1 special character.

constraints.customValidationMessage: Password must include at least 8 characters, have at least 1 letter, 1 number and 1 special character.
